title: Annual leave
text: Employees accrue 25 days of annual leave per year. Leave accrues monthly from your start date and appears in the HR portal on the first of each month. Short requests must be submitted at least two weeks in advance. Requests covering more than ten consecutive days additionally require director approval. Unused leave may be carried over up to a maximum of five days into the following year. Carried-over leave expires on 31 March.

title: Notice periods
text: The standard notice period for employees is 30 days. Senior engineers, staff engineers and managers serve a notice period of 60 days. Notice must be given in writing to your line manager. Garden leave may be applied at the company's discretion for roles with access to commercially sensitive material.

title: Probation
text: New joiners serve a probation period of three months. During probation the notice period on either side is one week. A probation review is held at six weeks and again at twelve weeks. Probation may be extended once, by a maximum of three months, and any extension must be confirmed in writing.

title: Parental leave
text: Primary caregivers are entitled to 26 weeks of paid parental leave. Secondary caregivers are entitled to 8 weeks of paid parental leave. Parental leave must begin within 12 months of the birth or placement. Keeping-in-touch days may be taken without ending the leave period.

title: Sickness absence
text: Report sickness absence to your line manager before 10am on the first day. A self-certification form covers absences of up to seven calendar days. A fit note from a doctor is required for absences longer than seven calendar days. Company sick pay is paid at full salary for the first 13 weeks in any rolling twelve-month period.

title: Remote working
text: Employees may work remotely up to three days per week by default. Fully remote arrangements require approval from a director. Teams may set core collaboration hours between 10am and 4pm. Working from outside your country of employment requires prior approval from HR for tax reasons and is capped at 20 working days per year.

title: VPN access
text: Remote access to internal systems requires the corporate VPN client. Install the client from the IT self-service portal. You must enrol a hardware security key before the VPN will authenticate you. Contact the service desk if enrolment fails after two attempts. The VPN disconnects idle sessions after 12 hours.

title: Laptop replacement
text: Laptops are replaced every three years. Replacement is triggered automatically by the asset management system and you will be contacted by IT. Damaged laptops must be reported to the service desk within one working day. Loaner machines are available while a repair is in progress. Personal devices may not be used to access production systems.

title: Passwords and MFA
text: Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for every internal system. Hardware security keys are issued to all engineers and to anyone holding administrative access. Password rotation is not required on a schedule; rotate only on suspicion of compromise. Shared accounts are prohibited without a documented exception.

title: Contacting the service desk
text: The service desk is staffed from 7am to 7pm on working days. Raise a ticket through the self-service portal for anything that is not blocking your work. Telephone the service desk for anything that is blocking. Out-of-hours support is available for production incidents only, through the on-call rota.

title: Software requests
text: Standard software is available for self-service installation from the company catalogue. Non-standard software requires a request approved by your manager and by security review. Open-source licences must be checked for compatibility before use in any product. Software purchased on personal expense will not be reimbursed.

title: Expense claims
text: Expense claims must be submitted within 60 days of the expense being incurred. Receipts are required for any claim over 25 pounds. Claims are reimbursed in the payroll run following approval by your manager. Travel booked outside the corporate booking tool will not be reimbursed without a documented exception.

title: Travel booking
text: All business travel must be booked through the corporate travel tool. Economy class is standard for flights under six hours. Premium economy may be booked for flights over six hours with director approval. Hotel spend is capped at 200 pounds per night in most cities and 300 pounds in London, New York and Tokyo.

title: Procurement
text: Any purchase over 5000 pounds requires a purchase order raised before the commitment is made. Purchases over 25000 pounds additionally require finance director approval. Vendors must complete a security assessment before any contract is signed. Annual contracts renew automatically unless cancelled 60 days before the renewal date.

title: Payroll
text: Salaries are paid on the last working day of each month. Payslips are available in the HR portal three working days before payday. Changes to bank details must be made in the portal and are subject to a verification call. Payroll queries should be raised with the payroll team rather than with your manager.

title: Security incidents
text: Report suspected security incidents immediately to the security team. Do not attempt to investigate a suspected compromise yourself. The on-call security engineer is reachable at any hour through the incident hotline. Preserve any evidence and do not power off the affected machine. A post-incident review is held within five working days of resolution.

title: Phishing
text: Report suspected phishing using the report button in the mail client. Do not forward a suspected phishing message to colleagues. The security team will confirm whether a reported message was malicious. Credential entry on a phishing page must be reported immediately so the account can be locked.

title: Data classification
text: Data is classified using four classification levels: public, internal, confidential and restricted. Customer data is confidential at minimum and restricted where it contains financial or health information. Restricted data may not leave approved systems. Confidential data may not be pasted into third-party tools that have not completed a security assessment.

title: Access reviews
text: Access to production systems is reviewed quarterly. Managers must confirm that each of their reports still requires the access they hold. Access not confirmed within 14 days of the review opening is revoked automatically. Break-glass accounts are reviewed monthly and every use is investigated.

title: On-call
text: Engineers join the on-call rota after completing onboarding and two shadow shifts. A shift lasts one week and runs from Wednesday morning to the following Wednesday morning. Compensation for on-call is paid as a weekly allowance plus time off in lieu for any night-time page. You may swap a shift with another engineer by agreement, recorded in the rota tool.

title: Deployment
text: Deployments to production require a passing pipeline and one approving review. Deployments are frozen between 4pm Friday and 9am Monday except for incident fixes. Every deployment must be revertible by a single command. Database migrations are deployed separately from application code and must be backwards compatible with the running version.

title: Code review
text: Every change requires at least one approving review before merge. Changes touching authentication, authorisation or payment handling require two approvals, one of which must be from the owning team. Reviews should be returned within one working day. A review is not a rubber stamp and reviewers are accountable for what they approve.

title: Production incidents
text: Declare an incident in the incident channel as soon as customer impact is suspected. The first responder takes the incident commander role until it is handed over explicitly. Status updates are posted every 30 minutes while an incident is open. A written postmortem is required for any incident with customer impact and is blameless by policy.

title: Information security policy
text: This information security policy applies to every employee, contractor, consultant and third-party supplier who accesses any company system, network, application or data repository, whether that access takes place on company premises, at a customer site, or from any remote location whatsoever. All personnel are required to complete the annual information security awareness training within thirty days of the training being assigned to them by the learning management system, and line managers are accountable for ensuring that every member of their team has completed the training within that window. Any exception to any provision of this policy must be requested in writing, reviewed by the security team, approved by an appropriate member of the senior leadership team, recorded in the exceptions register, and reviewed again at intervals of no more than twelve months. Failure to comply with the requirements set out in this policy may result in the withdrawal of system access, disciplinary action in accordance with the disciplinary procedure, and in the most serious cases termination of employment or of the contract for services. The security team maintains the authoritative version of this policy and will communicate any material change to all personnel through the usual internal communication channels.

title: Code of conduct
text: Every person working at or on behalf of the company is expected to conduct themselves with honesty, integrity and professional courtesy in all dealings with colleagues, customers, suppliers, regulators and members of the public, both during working hours and in any situation where they could reasonably be understood to be representing the company. Discrimination, harassment, bullying and victimisation of any kind are prohibited without exception, and any person who believes they have experienced or witnessed such behaviour is encouraged to raise the matter with their line manager, with any member of the people team, or through the confidential reporting line operated by an independent third party. Conflicts of interest, including outside employment, directorships, significant shareholdings in competitors or suppliers, and close personal relationships with anyone involved in a procurement decision, must be declared promptly to the people team so that appropriate arrangements can be put in place. The company will not retaliate against any person who raises a concern in good faith, and any attempt at retaliation will itself be treated as a serious breach of this code.

title: Supplier management policy
text: All prospective suppliers must complete the standard due diligence questionnaire covering financial standing, information security controls, data protection arrangements, business continuity provisions, and compliance with applicable anti-bribery and modern slavery legislation before any commitment is made on behalf of the company. The business owner for each supplier relationship is responsible for maintaining the relationship record, for ensuring that contractual obligations are being met in practice rather than merely on paper, and for escalating any material concern to the procurement team at the earliest opportunity. Supplier performance is reviewed at intervals appropriate to the criticality of the service provided, with suppliers categorised as critical reviewed at least quarterly and all other suppliers reviewed at least annually. Where a supplier processes personal data on behalf of the company, a data processing agreement incorporating the required contractual clauses must be executed before any personal data is transferred.
